rows.prompt: A single cannabis leaf with seven slender serrated fingers glows against the rising sun on a hillside, its veins shining like thin rivers of gold, a soft veil of smoke drifting past it, luminous anime film illustration with hand-painted backgrounds, soft glowing light and rich atmosphere. Close-up, the leaf in the center of the frame, misty green hills and a huge sunrise behind it, light flares streaming across the sky. Warm golden backlight, colors of gold, deep green, peach and soft sky blue, no people, no text, no watermark, luminous anime film style.

Bright morning sun from the right, colors of cream white, sky blue, leaf green and gold, no people, no text, no watermark, luminous anime film style.
